title: About TechStore
text: TechStore is an online-only consumer electronics retailer in India. It has no physical retail stores or showrooms, so there are no store opening hours; orders are placed only on the TechStore website and app. TechStore sells six product families: headphones and earbuds (SoundWave), laptops (PulseBook), tablets (NovaTab), smartwatches (AuraWatch), monitors (ClearView), and chargers and power banks (VoltCharge, VoltBank). TechStore does not sell mobile phones, televisions, cameras, gaming consoles, or home appliances such as washing machines, refrigerators, or air conditioners. Repairs are handled at authorised service centres in 48 cities. Customer support is available by chat and email from 9 AM to 9 PM IST, seven days a week.

title: Return Window
text: TechStore accepts returns within 30 days of delivery. The 30 days are counted from the delivery date shown on the tracking record, not the order date. Items must be returned in their original packaging with all accessories, manuals and free gifts included. A return raised on day 31 or later is rejected automatically by the returns system.

title: Non-Returnable Items
text: For hygiene reasons the following are non-returnable once the seal is broken: headphones of every type (over-ear, on-ear and in-ear), earbuds, fitness bands worn on the wrist, and any personal grooming device. Opened software licences and redeemed digital gift cards are also non-returnable. These items remain covered by warranty if they are faulty; a hygiene exclusion never removes warranty rights.

title: Refund Processing Time
text: Once a returned item is received and inspected at our warehouse, refunds are initiated within 2 business days. The money reaches the original payment method in 5 to 7 business days for cards and UPI, and up to 10 business days for net banking. Refunds are always issued to the original payment method; we cannot redirect a refund to a different card or account.

title: Exchange Policy
text: An exchange can be requested within 30 days of delivery for a different size, colour or variant of the same product line, subject to stock. If the new variant costs more, the difference is charged before dispatch. If it costs less, the difference is refunded. Only one exchange is permitted per order line.

title: Order Cancellation
text: An order can be cancelled free of charge at any time before it is marked Shipped. Once shipped, cancellation is not possible; the customer should refuse delivery or raise a return after delivery. Cancelled orders are refunded in full, including any delivery charge paid, within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Price Match Guarantee
text: If a customer finds the identical product cheaper on a competing authorised Indian retailer within 7 days of their purchase, TechStore refunds the difference. The competing listing must be for a new, sealed unit sold and shipped by the retailer itself, not a marketplace seller. Price matching does not apply during flash sales or clearance events.

title: Standard Warranty Terms
text: All products carry the manufacturer warranty stated on the product page, counted from the delivery date. Warranty covers manufacturing defects and component failure under normal use. It does not cover physical damage, liquid ingress, unauthorised repair, or normal battery capacity decline above 80 percent of the rated capacity. Warranty is independent of the 30-day return window: a product outside the return window may still be repaired or replaced under warranty.

title: How to Raise a Warranty Claim
text: To claim warranty, raise a service request from Orders in the account, or contact support with the order ID. TechStore arranges a free pickup for products above ₹5,000; smaller items are shipped by the customer and reimbursed up to ₹200. Diagnosis takes 3 to 5 business days at the service centre. If the unit is found defective it is repaired or replaced; if no fault is found it is returned at no charge.

title: Damaged or Wrong Item Delivered
text: If an item arrives damaged, or the wrong item is delivered, report it within 48 hours of delivery with photographs of the package and product. TechStore arranges a free replacement pickup and dispatches the correct item immediately. No return shipping charge applies and the 30-day window does not limit this remedy.

title: Customer Data and Privacy
text: TechStore stores order history, delivery addresses and payment metadata. Full card numbers are never stored. A customer may request deletion of their account and associated personal data by writing to privacy@techstore.example; deletion completes within 30 days. TechStore keeps invoice records for 8 years, including after an account is deleted.

title: Delivery Timelines
text: Metro cities: 1 to 2 business days. Tier-2 cities: 2 to 4 business days. Remote and north-eastern pin codes: 5 to 7 business days. Orders placed after 2 PM are processed the following business day. Delivery estimates exclude Sundays and national holidays.

title: Delivery Charges
text: Delivery is free on all orders above ₹999. Below that a flat ₹79 delivery charge applies. Express next-day delivery costs ₹149 and is available in metro cities only for orders placed before 2 PM. Delivery charges are refunded if the order is cancelled before shipping or if the item arrives damaged.

title: Tracking an Order
text: A tracking link is emailed and sent by SMS when the order is marked Shipped. Tracking can also be seen under Orders in the account. Tracking information can take up to 12 hours after dispatch to become active with the courier. If tracking has not updated for more than 48 hours, contact support so a courier trace can be raised.

title: International Shipping
text: TechStore ships within India only. We do not ship to international addresses and cannot deliver to APO or diplomatic addresses. Orders placed with an international billing address but an Indian delivery address are accepted.

title: Failed Delivery Attempts
text: The courier makes three delivery attempts on consecutive business days. After the third failed attempt the parcel is returned to our warehouse and the order is refunded in full, including any delivery charge paid, within 7 business days of the parcel being received back. A customer can reschedule delivery once through the tracking link.

title: Headphones Will Not Pair
text: If SoundWave headphones will not pair: 1) Hold the power button for 7 seconds until the LED flashes blue and white, which puts the unit in pairing mode. 2) On the phone, forget any existing SoundWave entry in Bluetooth settings. 3) Disable Bluetooth for 10 seconds, re-enable, and select the device. 4) If multipoint is active the headphones may already be connected to another device; disconnect there first. 5) If the LED does not flash at all, charge for 30 minutes and retry.

title: Headphone Battery Draining Fast
text: Rapid battery drain on SoundWave headphones is usually caused by active noise cancellation combined with high volume. ANC reduces rated battery life by roughly 30 percent. Check for firmware updates in the SoundWave app, disable multipoint if two devices are not needed, and confirm the unit powers off rather than idling when removed. If runtime is below 50 percent of the rated figure with ANC off, the battery is considered defective and covered under warranty.

title: Laptop Not Charging
text: If a PulseBook will not charge: 1) Confirm the charger wattage matches the model; the PulseBook Pro 16 needs 100 W and will charge very slowly or not at all on a 65 W unit. 2) Try the other Thunderbolt port; the right-hand port on the PulseBook 14 supports charging. 3) Inspect the cable for damage. 4) Hold the power button for 15 seconds to reset the embedded controller. 5) If the charging LED never illuminates with a known-good charger, raise a warranty service request.

title: Smartwatch Not Syncing
text: If AuraWatch 3 will not sync: confirm the companion app has Bluetooth and background-activity permission, confirm the phone runs Android 9 or later or iOS 14 or later, force-close and reopen the app, and ensure the watch firmware is current. Battery optimisation settings on some Android phones stop the app in the background and are the most common cause; exclude the app from optimisation.

title: Monitor Shows No Signal
text: If ClearView 27 reports no signal: 1) Confirm the input source matches the cable used, selectable in the on-screen menu. 2) For USB-C, confirm the laptop port supports DisplayPort Alt Mode; the PulseBook USB-A port does not. 3) Try a different cable, as many USB-C cables carry power but not video. 4) At 4K 144 Hz use DisplayPort 1.4 or HDMI 2.1; older cables cap the refresh rate. 5) Reset the monitor to factory defaults from the menu.

title: Accepted Payment Methods
text: TechStore accepts UPI, credit and debit cards from all major Indian issuers, net banking from 40 partner banks, and cash on delivery for orders up to ₹20,000. Wallet payments and international cards are not accepted. Cash on delivery carries a ₹49 handling fee which is refunded if the order is cancelled before dispatch.

title: Payment Failed but Money Debited
text: If a payment fails but the amount is debited, the bank has placed a temporary hold that is released automatically. Card and UPI holds reverse within 5 to 7 business days; net banking can take up to 10. No order is created for a failed payment, so there is nothing to cancel. If the amount has not reversed after the stated period, contact support with the bank reference number and TechStore raises a chargeback trace with the payment gateway.

title: Duplicate or Multiple Charges
text: A duplicate charge occurs when a payment page is submitted more than once. Only one order is created; the additional authorisations are holds that reverse automatically within 5 to 7 business days. If two or more distinct orders were created, each must be cancelled separately and each refund is processed separately, so a customer may see refunds arrive on different days. When resolving a multi-charge dispute, list every charge with its date and amount, state which one corresponds to the surviving order, and give the expected reversal date for each of the others.

title: EMI and No-Cost EMI
text: EMI is available on credit cards from 12 partner banks for orders above ₹5,000, over 3, 6, 9 or 12 months. No-cost EMI is offered on selected products, where TechStore absorbs the interest as an upfront discount. If an order paid by no-cost EMI is returned, the discount is deducted from the refund and the bank may still charge interest already levied; the bank must be contacted to cancel the EMI plan.

title: Invoice and GST
text: A tax invoice is emailed within 24 hours of dispatch and is downloadable from Orders. Business customers who need their GSTIN on the invoice must enter it at checkout, before placing the order. TechStore cannot add a GSTIN to an invoice afterwards and does not issue a fresh invoice for a completed order. Invoices remain downloadable for 8 years.

title: Partial Refunds on Multi-Item Orders
text: When only some items in an order are returned, the refund covers the returned items' value. The delivery charge is refunded only if the entire order is returned. If a promotional discount applied to the order required a minimum basket value and the remaining items fall below it, the discount is recalculated and the difference deducted from the refund.

title: TechStore Partner API Overview
text: The Partner API is a REST API at https://api.techstore.example/v1. All requests require an Authorization header with a bearer token issued in the partner dashboard. Requests and responses are JSON. The API exposes orders, inventory, shipments and webhooks. Sandbox is available at https://sandbox.techstore.example/v1 with separate credentials and synthetic data.

title: API Authentication and 401 Errors
text: Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <token>. A 401 means the token is missing, malformed, expired or from the wrong environment; sandbox tokens rejected by production is the most common cause. Tokens expire 90 days after issue and can be rotated in the dashboard without downtime, since the previous token stays valid for 24 hours after rotation.

title: Webhook Signature Verification and 403 Errors
text: Every webhook carries an X-TechStore-Signature header containing an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, keyed with the webhook secret, hex encoded. A 403 returned by our delivery checker almost always means the signature was computed over a parsed and re-serialised body rather than the raw bytes; JSON re-serialisation changes key order and whitespace and therefore changes the HMAC. Compute the HMAC over the exact raw body before any JSON parsing. The second most common cause is using the API token instead of the webhook secret as the HMAC key.

title: API Rate Limits and 429 Errors
text: The Partner API allows 600 requests per minute per token, and 60 per minute for the bulk export endpoints. Exceeding the limit returns 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds. Clients should honour Retry-After and use exponential backoff with jitter. Sustained violation for more than 15 minutes results in a temporary 1-hour block.

title: API Error Codes
text: 400 invalid request body or missing required field. 401 authentication failed. 403 signature verification failed or the token lacks the required scope. 404 resource not found, including a valid order ID belonging to a different partner. 409 idempotency conflict, meaning the same Idempotency-Key was reused with a different payload. 422 the request was well formed but semantically rejected, such as shipping to an unsupported pin code. 429 rate limited. 5xx a server error; retry with backoff.

title: API Idempotency
text: All POST endpoints accept an Idempotency-Key header. A repeated request with the same key and an identical payload returns the original response without creating a second resource. A repeated key with a different payload returns 409. Keys are retained for 24 hours. Clients should generate a UUID per logical operation, not per HTTP attempt, so that retries reuse the same key.

title: Creating and Verifying an Account
text: An account is created with an email address or an Indian mobile number and verified by a one-time password valid for 10 minutes. A maximum of five OTPs may be requested per hour. An account is required to place an order; guest checkout is not offered.

title: Password Reset
text: Use Forgot Password on the sign-in page. A reset link valid for 30 minutes is emailed. If the email does not arrive, check spam and confirm the address matches the registered one; for privacy we do not disclose whether an address is registered. After three failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.

title: Changing a Delivery Address
text: The delivery address can be changed from Orders until the order is marked Shipped. After dispatch the address cannot be changed, but delivery can be rescheduled once through the courier tracking link. Changing the address to a different pin code after dispatch is not possible; the order must be refused and reordered.

title: Order History and Invoices
text: All orders from the past 8 years are visible under Orders in the account, with status, tracking and downloadable invoice. Orders placed as part of a cancelled payment attempt do not appear, because no order is created for a failed payment.

title: Service Centre Network
text: TechStore operates authorised service centres in 48 Indian cities. The nearest centre can be found by pin code on the Support page. Walk-in service is available for laptops and monitors; headphones, watches and tablets are handled by courier pickup only. Carry the invoice or order ID for any walk-in visit.

title: Out-of-Warranty Repair
text: Out-of-warranty repairs are chargeable. A diagnosis fee of ₹499 applies and is waived if the repair is approved. A quotation is shared before any work begins and no work proceeds without approval. Repaired parts carry a 90-day warranty on the replaced component only.

title: Accidental Damage Protection
text: PulseBook 14 and PulseBook Pro 16 include one year of accidental damage protection from the delivery date, covering drops and liquid spills. One claim is permitted in the coverage year, with a customer contribution of 10 percent of the product price. Accidental damage protection does not cover theft, loss, or cosmetic damage that does not affect function.

title: Only One Earbud Working
text: If only one SoundWave earbud plays: 1) Place both buds in the case, close the lid for 10 seconds and reopen. 2) Forget the device in phone Bluetooth settings and re-pair. 3) Reset the buds by holding both touch panels for 15 seconds until the LED flashes red and white. 4) Clean the charging contacts on the silent bud with a dry cloth; contact dirt is the most common cause. 5) If the silent bud still does not charge, it is a warranty defect.

title: Earbud Case Not Charging
text: If the charging case does not charge: confirm the cable is USB-C and carries data or power, try a different 5 V adapter, and check the LED responds when plugged in. A case left fully discharged for over a month may need 15 minutes before any LED appears. If no LED appears after 30 minutes on a known-good charger, raise a warranty claim.

title: Laptop Running Slowly
text: For a PulseBook running slowly: check available storage, as NVMe drives slow markedly above 90 percent full; open Task Manager to identify background processes; confirm the power mode is not set to Battery Saver while plugged in; and update the chipset and graphics drivers. The PulseBook Air 13 with 8 GB RAM will swap under heavy multitasking; this is expected behaviour, not a defect.

title: Laptop Overheating
text: Surface temperatures up to 45 C under sustained load are within specification. If the machine thermally throttles or shuts down: ensure the vents are unobstructed and not used on fabric, clean the intake grilles with compressed air, and update the BIOS. Shutdowns under light load indicate a fan or sensor fault and are covered by warranty.

title: Smartwatch Battery Draining Fast
text: Always-on display reduces AuraWatch Pro battery life from 18 days to roughly 6. Continuous SpO2 monitoring and dual-band GPS also shorten runtime substantially. Disable always-on display and continuous SpO2 to restore rated life. If runtime is under 50 percent of the rated figure with those features off, the battery is a warranty defect.

title: Heart Rate Readings Inaccurate
text: Optical heart-rate sensors need firm skin contact. Wear the watch one finger-width above the wrist bone, snug but not tight. Tattoos, very cold skin and loose fits all reduce accuracy. If readings remain implausible when stationary after adjusting fit, the sensor is a warranty defect.

title: Monitor Flickering
text: Flicker at high refresh rates is usually a cable limitation. For 4K at 144 Hz or above use a certified DisplayPort 1.4 or HDMI 2.1 cable under 2 metres. Disable adaptive sync temporarily to test. If flicker persists at 60 Hz with a known-good cable, the panel is a warranty defect.

title: Monitor Not Charging Laptop over USB-C
text: The ClearView 27 supplies 90 W and the ClearView 32 Ultra supplies 140 W over USB-C. A PulseBook Pro 16 drawing 100 W will charge slowly from a ClearView 27 under sustained load. Confirm the cable is rated for both video and 100 W power delivery; many are not. Verify USB-C power delivery is enabled in the monitor menu, as it is off by default on some firmware.

title: Power Bank Not Charging Devices
text: The VoltBank 20000 requires a double press of the power button to begin output for low-draw devices such as earbuds. For laptops, use the 65 W USB-C port, not the USB-A port. If the capacity display shows charge but no output occurs on any port, raise a warranty claim.

title: Refund to a Closed or Expired Card
text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method. If that card is closed or expired, the issuing bank still routes the credit to the underlying account in most cases. If the bank rejects the credit, the funds return to TechStore within 10 business days, after which support can arrange a bank transfer once account details and identity are verified. We cannot refund to a different card at the customer's request when the original card is still active.

title: Refunds on Cash-on-Delivery Orders
text: Cash-on-delivery orders cannot be refunded to a payment method because none was used. Refunds are made by bank transfer after the customer submits account number and IFSC through the secure link sent by support. Transfers complete within 5 to 7 business days of verification. The ₹49 COD handling fee is refunded only if the order is cancelled before dispatch.

title: Promotional Codes and Stacking
text: One promotional code applies per order. Codes cannot be combined with each other or with no-cost EMI unless the code explicitly states otherwise. A code cannot be applied after an order is placed and a replacement order is required. Codes tied to a minimum basket value are void if returns take the order below that value, and the discount is recovered from the refund.

title: Price Drop After Purchase
text: If a product's TechStore price drops within 7 days of purchase, the difference is refunded on request. This applies once per order line and does not apply during flash sales, festive events or clearance. This is distinct from the price match guarantee, which covers competitor pricing.

title: Gift Cards and Store Credit
text: Gift cards are valid for 12 months from issue and can be used across multiple orders. They cannot be exchanged for cash. If an order paid partly by gift card is returned, the gift-card portion is refunded as store credit and the remainder to the original payment method. Redeemed gift cards are non-returnable.

title: Bank Chargebacks and Disputes
text: If a customer raises a chargeback with their bank, the order is frozen and any parallel TechStore refund is suspended to prevent a double credit. Chargebacks take 45 to 90 days to resolve through the card network. Contacting support directly is almost always faster than a chargeback, and support can withdraw a chargeback by providing the bank with resolution evidence.

title: API Pagination
text: List endpoints return at most 100 records per page and a cursor in the next_cursor field. Pass it as the cursor query parameter for the next page; a null next_cursor means the end. Cursors expire after 30 minutes. Do not construct cursors; treat them as opaque strings. Offset-based paging is not supported.

title: Webhook Delivery and Retries
text: Webhooks expect a 2xx response within 5 seconds. Non-2xx or timeout triggers retries at 1, 5, 25 and 125 minutes, then the endpoint is marked unhealthy and deliveries pause until reactivated in the dashboard. Handlers must be idempotent, because a duplicate delivery is possible even after a successful response. Each delivery carries an X-TechStore-Delivery-Id that is stable across retries.

title: Webhook Event Types
text: Available events: order.created, order.shipped, order.delivered, order.cancelled, order.returned, refund.initiated, refund.completed, inventory.low. Events are subscribed per endpoint in the dashboard. Payloads include the event type, a timestamp, and the affected resource. Event ordering is not guaranteed; use the timestamp rather than arrival order.

title: Sandbox Environment
text: Sandbox runs at https://sandbox.techstore.example/v1 with separate credentials and synthetic data that resets nightly at 02:00 IST. Sandbox order IDs begin with a 9; production IDs do not. Webhooks fire in sandbox but use a separate signing secret. Sandbox has no rate limit but is not performance representative.

title: API Versioning and Deprecation
text: The API is versioned in the URL path. Breaking changes ship as a new version; additive changes such as new response fields ship within the current version, so clients must ignore unknown fields rather than fail. A deprecated version is supported for 12 months after its successor is announced, with a Sunset header on every response during that period.

title: API Timeouts and Retry Safety
text: Requests time out server side at 30 seconds. A timeout does not indicate whether the operation completed, so POST requests must be retried with the same Idempotency-Key to avoid duplicates. GET, PUT and DELETE are idempotent by design and safe to retry. Retries should use exponential backoff with jitter; retrying immediately in a tight loop triggers rate limiting.

title: Inventory Endpoint
text: GET /v1/inventory returns stock by SKU and warehouse. Quantities are eventually consistent with up to 60 seconds of lag, so a successful inventory read does not guarantee a subsequent order will succeed; handle 422 out_of_stock on order creation. The inventory.low webhook fires when a SKU falls below its configured threshold.

title: Token Scopes and 403 Errors
text: Tokens carry scopes: orders:read, orders:write, inventory:read, shipments:read, webhooks:manage. A 403 with code insufficient_scope means the token is valid but lacks the required scope, which is different from a signature failure. Scopes are set when the token is created and cannot be widened afterwards; issue a new token instead.

title: Bulk and Business Orders
text: Orders above 10 units of a single SKU are treated as business orders and require a GSTIN. Bulk pricing is quoted by the business desk and is not available at checkout. Business orders ship in 5 to 10 business days and carry a 15-day return window rather than 30 days.

title: Pre-Orders
text: Pre-ordered items are charged at the time of order, not at dispatch. The estimated dispatch date on the product page is indicative; if it slips by more than 14 days the customer may cancel for a full refund. The 30-day return window begins at delivery, not at the order date.

title: Warranty on Replaced Units
text: When a unit is replaced under warranty, the replacement inherits the remaining warranty of the original; it does not start a fresh term. If fewer than 90 days remain, the replacement carries 90 days from the replacement date. Replacement units may be factory refurbished and are functionally equivalent with matching cosmetic grade.

title: Open-Box Delivery
text: Open-box delivery is available in 22 cities on orders above ₹20,000. The courier opens the package in the customer's presence for inspection before handover. Refusal at open-box inspection is free and refunds process within 5 to 7 business days. Open-box delivery adds 1 business day to the estimate.

title: Installation and Demo
text: Free installation and demo is included for monitors above 27 inches and is scheduled within 48 hours of delivery. Laptops, tablets, headphones and watches do not require installation. Installation requests are raised from Orders after the item is delivered.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
text: Two-factor authentication can be enabled from Security in the account, using an authenticator app or SMS. Enabling 2FA signs out all other sessions. To disable 2FA, current authentication is required; if the device is lost, identity is verified with the last order details and a government ID, and removal takes up to 48 hours.
